text:
𝗪𝗘𝗟𝗟𝗜𝗡𝗚𝗧𝗢𝗡 𝗧𝗘𝗦𝗧 𝗗𝗥𝗔𝗪𝗡! 🇮🇳

India declared at 720/9; NZ held on at 239/5 in their second innings, still 113 behind.
Bumrah took 4/92 earlier.

India deserved more? 👇
#INDvNZ #TeamIndia
